qe: Who is universally regarded as the 'Father of Genetics' for discovering the fundamental laws of inheritance?
qh: वंशानुगति के मूलभूत नियमों की खोज के लिए 'आनुवंशिकी का जनक' (Father of Genetics) किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Gregor Johann Mendel (ek Austria ke mohri, parish priest) ne 1856-63 me matar (pea) ke paudhon par 7 saal experiment karke sabse pehle bataya ki characters (gun) 'factors' (genes) ke roop me maa-baap se bacche me jaate hain, aur unke ek-ek niyam (dominance, segregation, independent assortment) diye - isliye unhe 'Father of Genetics' kehte hain (aaj unhe 'Father of Modern Genetics' bhi kehte hain). Baaki teen aage ke scientists hain: James Watson (DNA double helix, 1953), Charles Darwin (evolution), Thomas Hunt Morgan (linkage/Drosophila). Exam point: 'Genetics ke janak = Mendel (matar ke paudhe par kaam)'.

qe: Which plant species was specifically chosen by Gregor Mendel for his hybridization genetics experiments?
qh: ग्रेगर मेंडल ने अपने प्रसिद्ध आनुवंशिकी प्रयोगों के लिए किस पौधे की प्रजाति को चुना था?
e: Concept: Mendel ne apne experiment ke liye khaas matar - Garden Pea (Pisum sativum) - chuni, kyunki usme kuch khaas fayde the: (1) ye self-pollinating hai par cross karana aasan (2) jaldi badhta hai, (3) uske characters do saaf roop me milte hain (lamba/chhota, gol/jhurridaar) aur (4) pehle se koi hybrid naam ki chakkar nahi thi. Baaki teen paudhe baad me doosre scientists ne use kiye: Snapdragon (incomplete dominance ke liye), Sweet Pea (Bateson/Punnett - linkage), aur Wild Mustard (Brassica). Exam point: 'Mendel ka experimental plant = Garden pea (Pisum sativum)'.

qe: The observable physical or biochemical manifestation of an expressed genetic trait is called the:
qh: किसी जीन द्वारा व्यक्त किए गए शारीरिक या बाहरी दृश्य लक्षण को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Gene (gun ka aadhaar) aur uska dikhne wala roop do alag cheezein hain: Genotype = organism ke andar ka gene-code (jaise TT, Tt), aur Phenotype = bahar se dikhne wala ya naapne wala roop (jaise lamba, kaala, A blood group, koi disease) - ye gene + environment milkar banta hai. Baaki teen alag terms hain: Idiogram ek chromosome ka diagram, Karyotype ek cell ke saare chromosomes ka arrangement/photo, Genome poore DNA ka bhar. Exam point: 'Andar ka gene = Genotype; bahar ka dikhne wala gun = Phenotype'.

qe: What biological term describes alternative, variant molecular forms of a given gene residing at a homologous locus?
qh: किसी एक ही जीन के वैकल्पिक रूपों को क्या कहा जाता है जो एक ही गुणसूत्र स्थल पर पाए जाते हैं?
e: Concept: Ek hi gene ke kai roop (variant) ho sakte hain - jaise blood group ka gene A, B ya O, ya matar me T aur t - aise alag-alag version ko Alleles (allelomorphs) kehte hain, aur wo homologous (jodi wale) chromosome par ek hi jagah (locus) par baithe hote hain. Baaki teen alag cheezein hain: Centromere chromosome ka jodne wala hissa, Cistron gene ka functional hissa, Histone DNA lapetne wala protein. Exam point: 'Ek gene ke alag roop = Alleles (ek maa se, ek baap se)'.

qe: According to the Law of Dominance, crossing a pure homozygous Tall (TT) pea plant with a pure Dwarf (tt) plant produces an F1 generation that is:
qh: प्रभाविता के नियम के अनुसार, शुद्ध लंबे (TT) और शुद्ध बौने (tt) पौधे के संकरण से F1 पीढ़ी कैसी प्राप्त होती है?
e: Concept: Law of Dominance kehta hai ki jab do bilkul shuddh (homozygous) ulta lakshan wale paudhe cross karte hain (TT lamba aur tt chhota) to F1 me sirf ek hi lakshan dikhta hai - lamba (Tt) - kyunki T dominate karta hai aur t chhupa (recessive) rehta hai; isliye F1 me saare heterozygotes lambe hote hain (chhota lakshan gayab nahi hota, sirf chhipa rehta hai aur F2 me wapas nikalta hai). Baaki teen galat hain: medium height (ye incomplete dominance hoti hai), saare dwarf, ya 50-50 - law of dominance me aisa nahi hota. Exam point: 'Pure tall x pure dwarf = F1 sab Tt (tall) - ek hi lakshan dikhta hai'.

qe: What is the classical phenotypic ratio obtained in the F2 generation of a Mendelian Monohybrid cross?
qh: मेंडल के एकसंकर संकरण (Monohybrid Cross) की F2 पीढ़ी में दिखने वाला लक्षणप्ररूपी अनुपात (Phenotypic Ratio) क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Monohybrid cross ke F2 me (F1 ko khud se cross karne par, Tt x Tt) phenotypes ka ratio 3:1 aata hai: 3 lamba (1 TT + 2 Tt) aur 1 chhota (tt); iska matlab dominant lakshan 3/4 me dikhta hai aur recessive 1/4 me. Baaki teen alag ratios hain: 9:3:3:1 (dihybrid cross ka), 1:1 (test cross ka), aur 1:2:1 (genotypic ratio, phenotype nahi). Exam point: 'Monohybrid F2 phenotype ratio = 3:1; genotype ratio = 1:2:1'. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar 3:1 (3 Dominant : 1 Recessive) hai. Is tathya ko aankdon tatha maapdandon ke saath jodkar yaad rakhna zyada kaam aata hai.

qe: What is the precise genotypic ratio observed in the F2 generation of a Mendelian Monohybrid cross?
qh: मेंडल के एकसंकर संकरण की F2 पीढ़ी में प्राप्त होने वाला जीनप्ररूपी अनुपात (Genotypic Ratio) क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Genotype ka matlab gene-code ka hisaab hai; monohybrid ke F2 me (Tt x Tt se) genes aise batte hain: 1 TT (pure tall) : 2 Tt (hybrid tall) : 1 tt (pure dwarf) - yaani 1:2:1. Dhyaan rakho ki phenotype (bahar ka dikhne wala roop) 3:1 hota hai kyunki TT aur Tt dono lambe dikhte hain, par genes ka asli hisaab 1:2:1 hai. Baaki teen alag ratios hain: 3:1 (phenotype), 2:1:1 (ek khaas case), 9:3:3:1 (dihybrid). Exam point: 'Monohybrid F2 genotype ratio = 1:2:1'.

qe: Which Mendelian universal law states that two alleles of a gene pair segregate cleanly without blending during gametogenesis?
qh: कौन सा नियम यह बताता है कि युग्मक बनते समय दोनों एलील बिना किसी मिलावट के एक-दूसरे से शुद्ध अलग हो जाते हैं?
e: Concept: Law of Segregation (Purity of Gametes) kehta hai ki ek jodi ke do alleles gametes (sperm/egg) banane ke waqt bilkul saaf alag ho jate hain - ek gamete me sirf ek allele jaata hai (T ya t, dono nahi), aur koi blending (milavat) nahi hoti. Isi wajah se F1 ka chhupa hua lakshan F2 me wapas nikal aata hai - ye Mendel ka doosra niyam hai (pehla Law of Dominance). Baaki teen alag niyam hain: Independent assortment (dihybrid ke liye), Law of Dominance, aur Linkage (genes ka saath rehna). Exam point: 'Ek gamete me ek hi allele = Law of Segregation (purity of gametes)'.

qe: The F2 generation of a Mendelian Dihybrid cross involving two independent traits yields which phenotypic ratio?
qh: दो लक्षणों को ध्यान में रखकर किए गए मेंडल के द्विसंकर संकरण (Dihybrid Cross) की F2 पीढ़ी का अनुपात क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Dihybrid cross me do characters ek saath dekhe jate hain (jaise seed ka rang aur shape - YYRR x yyrr); F1 (YyRr) ko khud se cross karne par F2 me 16 ke hisaab se 9:3:3:1 ratio aata hai: 9 dono dominant, 3 pehla dominant-doosra recessive, 3 ulta, aur 1 dono recessive. Ye ratio Mendel ke do niyam se banta hai - segregation aur independent assortment (do gene alag-alag chromosome par ho to swatantra baantte hain). Baaki teen ratios galat hain (1:2:1 monohybrid, 3:1 monohybrid, 1:1:1:1 test cross). Exam point: 'Dihybrid F2 phenotypic ratio = 9:3:3:1'.

qe: When crossing red (RR) and white (rr) flowers of Mirabilis jalapa (4 o'clock plant) produces pink (Rr) F1 progeny, this demonstrates:
qh: गुलअब्बास (Mirabilis jalapa) में लाल और सफेद फूलों के संकरण से F1 पीढ़ी में गुलाबी (Pink) फूल आना किसका उदाहरण है?
e: Concept: Mirabilis jalapa (4 o'clock plant) me laal (RR) aur safed (rr) cross karne par F1 pink (Rr) nikla - yaani dono lakshan 'mix' ho gaye: ye Incomplete Dominance hai (yahan R poori tarah dominant nahi hai, isliye beech ka rang banta hai). Iska classic saboot ye hai ki F2 me ratio 1:2:1 hota hai (laal:pink:safed). Baaki teen alag hain: Complete dominance (Mendel - ek poora ubhar), Codominance (dono lakshan alag-alag saath dikhein - jaise AB blood group), Epistasis (ek gene doosre ko dhak de). Exam point: 'Mix rang (pink) = Incomplete Dominance (Mirabilis/4 o'clock plant)'.

qe: The human ABO blood group system exemplifies 'Codominance' specifically in which phenotype?
qh: मानव रक्त समूह प्रणाली में 'सह-प्रभाविता' (Codominance) का सबसे सटीक उदाहरण कौन सा रक्त समूह है?
o: Blood Group AB (IA and IB expressed equally)
e: Concept: Codominance me dono alleles apna-apna kaam 'saath-saath' karte hain (koi mix nahi, koi chhipa nahi) - iska best example human ABO blood group hai: Blood group AB (genotype IAIB) me RBC par A aur B dono antigens ek saath dikhte hain, kyunki IA aur IB dono ek saath express hote hain. Baaki teen groups me sirf ek hi antigen hota hai (A: IA, B: IB, O: koi nahi - O homozygous recessive ii hai). Exam point: 'Codominance = AB blood group (A aur B antigen saath dikhte hain)'.

qe: Which geneticist is designated the 'Father of Experimental Genetics' for discovering linkage and sex-linked inheritance using Drosophila melanogaster?
qh: ड्रोसोफिला मक्खी पर प्रयोग करके सहलग्नता (Linkage) की खोज करने वाले 'प्रायोगिक आनुवंशिकी के जनक' कौन हैं?
e: Concept: Thomas Hunt Morgan ne Drosophila melanogaster (fal ki makkhi) par kaam karke pehli baar dikhaya ki genes chromosomes par linear taur par saje hote hain, unme 'linkage' (ek hi chromosome ke genes saath chalte hain) hota hai, aur sex-linked (X chromosome se judi) bimariyan kaise failti hain - isliye unhe 'Father of Experimental Genetics' (aur Nobel 1933) kehte hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Mendel (classical genetics ka janak), Hugo de Vries (mutation theory), Francis Crick (DNA ka dhancha). Exam point: 'Linkage aur sex-linked inheritance ki khoj (Drosophila par) = T.H. Morgan'.

qe: A genetic cross between an organism showing a dominant phenotype and a homozygous recessive parent to determine its genotype is a:
qh: किसी अज्ञात जीनोटाइप वाले पौधे का जीनोटाइप पता करने के लिए उसका संकरण समयुग्मजी अप्रभावी (Homozygous Recessive) जनक से कराना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Jab koi organism dominant phenotype dikhata hai (jaise lamba) to uska genotype TT bhi ho sakta hai aur Tt bhi - pata karne ke liye usko homozygous recessive (tt - chhota) se cross kiya jata hai; ise Test Cross kehte hain. Agar saare bacche lambe aayein to parent TT tha (pure); agar aadhe lambe aadhe chhote aur ratio 1:1 aaye to parent Tt (hybrid) tha. Baaki teen alag crosses hain: Monohybrid selfing (F1 x F1), Back cross (parent me se kisi ek se cross), Reciprocal cross (gender ulta karke cross). Exam point: 'Dominant phenotype ka genotype pata karne ke liye = Test cross (homozygous recessive se)'.

qe: How many pairs of non-sex chromosomes ('Autosomes') are present in a normal diploid human somatic cell?
qh: एक सामान्य मानव कायिक कोशिका में 'ऑटोसोम' (Autosomes) के कितने जोड़े पाए जाते हैं?
e: Concept: Insaan me kul 23 jodi chromosomes hote hain - inme se 22 jodi 'autosomes' (non-sex chromosomes, matlab 44 chromosomes) hote hain jo sharir ke aam gun (rang, height, bimari) ke aite hain, aur 1 jodi sex chromosomes (XX ya XY) hoti hai jo ling (gender) decide karti hai. Baaki teen numbers galat hain: 1 jodi sex chromosome ka, 21/23 pair pure gametes/kul ka. Exam point: 'Autosomes = 22 pairs (44), Sex chromosomes = 1 pair (XX/XY), total 23 pairs = 46'.

qe: The biological sex of a human zygote is genetically determined at the moment of fertilization by:
qh: मानव भ्रूण का जैविक लिंग निषेचन के समय किसके गुणसूत्र द्वारा निर्धारित होता है?
o: The paternal heterogametic sperm delivering either an X or Y chromosome
The maternal X chromosome in the ovum
The cytoplasmic volume of the blastocyst
e: Concept: Maa ka egg hamesha X chromosome deta hai, isliye bacche ka gender poora baap ke shukraane (sperm) par nirbhar karta hai - agar sperm X le aaya to baccha ladki (XX) aur agar Y le aaya to ladka (XY) - ye faisla fertilization ke us pehle kshan me hi ho jata hai. Baaki teen external/theory galat hain: temperature (kuch sarisrip me hota hai, insaan me nahi), maa ka X (bacche ka gender decide nahi karta), aur cytoplasm ka size. Exam point: 'Insaan me gender baap (father) ke sperm se tay hota hai (X = girl, Y = boy)'.

qe: Classic Hemophilia (Factor VIII deficiency) and Red-Green Color Blindness are inherited as:
qh: हीमोफीलिया और लाल-हरा अंधापन (Color Blindness) किस प्रकार के आनुवंशिक विकार हैं?
e: Concept: X chromosome par kuch aise genes hote hain jinke liye Y par koi saathi nahi hota (isliye inhe X-linked kehte hain). Purush me sirf ek X hota hai, isliye ek bhi defective gene se wo bimari ho jata hai; aurat me do X hote hain, isliye ek kharab gene ko sahi doosra dhak leta hai (wo carrier banti hai, beemar nahi hoti - par beta beemar ho sakta hai). Hemophilia (Factor VIII ka na banna - khoon na jamna) aur Red-Green colour blindness isi X-linked recessive pattern se chalte hain. Baaki teen patterns alag hain: Y-linked (sirf purush), Autosomal dominant, Mitochondrial (sirf maa se). Exam point: 'Hemophilia + Colour blindness = X-linked recessive (purush zyada peedit)'.

qe: Who synthesized Sutton and Boveri's independent cytological findings into the comprehensive 'Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance'?
qh: 'वंशानुगति का गुणसूत्र सिद्धांत' (Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance) का प्रतिपादन 1902 में किसने किया था?
e: Concept: 1902-03 me Walter Sutton aur Theodor Boveri ne apne-alag kaam me dekha ki chromosomes ke behaviour (pairing, segregation) bilkul Mendel ke 'factors' (genes) ke behaviour jaise hai - dono ne milkar bataya ki genes chromosomes par hote hain aur unka baantna hi inheritance hai; ise Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance kehte hain. Baaki teen alag kaam se jude hain: Hardy-Weinberg (gene frequency/admixture), Avery-MacLeod-McCarty (DNA hi genetic material hai), Watson-Crick (DNA ka double helix). Exam point: 'Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance = Sutton aur Boveri (1902)'.

qe: Which human aneuploid chromosomal syndrome is produced by the nondisjunctive presence of an extra chromosome 21 (Trisomy 21)?
qh: 21वें गुणसूत्र की त्रिसूत्रता (Trisomy 21) के कारण कौन सा सिंड्रोम होता है, जिसमें बौद्धिक और शारीरिक विकास बाधित होता है?
e: Concept: Down Syndrome ek aneuploidy hai jisme chromosome 21 ki ek jodi ke bajaye teen copies hoti hain (Trisomy 21) - ye khaas kar aaisee umar ki maa me 'non-disjunction' (separation ki galti) se hota hai. Lakshan: chhota kad, gol-gol chaira, zubaan bahar, hatair mein bhatti (palmar crease), kam dimagi aur dil ki bimari; ye sabse aam aur sabse purana pehchana jaane wala chromosomal disorder hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Patau (Trisomy 13), Turner (X0), Cri-du-chat (chromosome 5 ka bhaag kam). Exam point: 'Trisomy 21 = Down syndrome (Mongolism)'.

qe: Klinefelter's Syndrome in phenotypic males is characterized by which aneuploid sex-chromosome constitution?
qh: क्लीनफेल्टर सिंड्रोम (Klinefelter's Syndrome) से पीड़ित पुरुषों में कौन सा गुणसूत्र संयोजन पाया जाता है?
e: Concept: Klinefelter's Syndrome me ladke (phenotypic male) ka chromosome pattern 47 XXY hota hai - ek extra X ki wajah se usme mardana lakshan kamzor pad jate hain: bura haddiyon ka lamaba, seene me thoda badhna (gynaecomastia), daadhi-mooch kam, aur shukraanein na banna (infertility) - isi wajah se pehchaan hoti hai. Baaki teen alag karyotypes hain: 45 X0 (Turner - ladki), 47 XYY (kuch bhi khaas nahi/behavioral), aur 46 XY SRY deletion (alag condition). Exam point: 'Klinefelter = 47, XXY (purush, infertility + gynaecomastia)'.

qe: Turner's Syndrome affecting phenotypic females is cytogenetically diagnosed by which monosomic karyotype?
qh: केवल महिलाओं को प्रभावित करने वाला टर्नर सिंड्रोम (Turner's Syndrome) किस गुणसूत्र मोनोसोमी के कारण होता है?
e: Concept: Turner's Syndrome me ladkiyaan (phenotypic female) ka karyotype 45 X0 hota hai - yaani ek X chromosome ki poori jodi nahi hoti (monosomy X). Lakshan: kad chhota, gardan ke kinare pankh (webbed neck), chhati chaudi (shield chest), bachchedaana poora nahi banata (infertility), aur dil/kidney ke kuch defect. Baaki teen karyotypes alag conditions hain: 47 XXY (Klinefelter), 46 XY female (Swyer), 47 XXX. Exam point: 'Turner = 45, X0 (monosomy X; ladki me chhota kad + infertility)'.

qe: Patau Syndrome, causing severe microcephaly, bilateral cleft lip/palate, and polydactyly, is cytogenetically caused by:
qh: कटा हुआ ऊपरी होंठ (Cleft Lip) और अतिरिक्त उंगलियों वाला 'पटाऊ सिंड्रोम' किस गुणसूत्र की विकृति से होता है?
e: Concept: Patau Syndrome Trisomy 13 (chromosome 13 ki extra copy) se hota hai - isme khaas lakshan hote hain: sir bahut chhota (microcephaly), hoth-talak (cleft lip/palate), hath-paanv me extra ungliyan (polydactyly), aankh/brain ke defect; bachche zyada tar kuch din/saal se zyada zinda nahi rehte. Baaki teen alag hain: Trisomy 21 (Down), Monosomy 5 (Cri-du-chat), Trisomy 18 (Edwards - yahan micrognathia/rock-bottom feet hote hain). Exam point: 'Patau = Trisomy 13 (cleft lip/palate + polydactyly); Edwards = 18; Down = 21'.

qe: Which pioneer molecular biologist is revered as the 'Father of DNA Fingerprinting' in India?
qh: भारत में 'डीएनए फिंगरप्रिंटिंग के जनक' के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है जिन्होंने सीसीएमबी (CCMB) की स्थापना की थी?
e: Concept: DNA Fingerprinting (DNA typing) ek aisi technique hai jisme insaan ke DNA ke khaas repeating hisse (STR) use karke har vyakti ki 'fingerprint' banayi jati hai - ye murder/crime ke maamlon me identity pakadne aur parivaar/relationship test karne me kaafi kaam aati hai. Bharat me iska asli pioneer Dr. Lalji Singh hain (CDFD Hyderabad me; unhone DNA fingerprinting ko India me laaya aur padhaya). Baaki teen alag scientists hain: Hargobind Khorana (gene synthesis), C.N.R. Rao (chemistry/nanomaterials), M.S. Swaminathan (green revolution). Exam point: 'Bharat me DNA fingerprinting ke janak = Dr. Lalji Singh'.

qe: The somatic cell nuclear transfer (SCNT) cloning technique produced the world's first cloned adult mammal in 1996, a sheep named:
qh: 1996 में कायिक कोशिका नाभिकीय स्थानांतरण (SCNT) द्वारा क्लोन की गई विश्व की पहली स्तनपायी भेड़ का नाम क्या था?
e: Concept: Cloning (SCNT - somatic cell nuclear transfer) me ek adult cell ka nucleus nikaal kar usko kisi egg se juda karke naya jeev banaya jata hai - 1996 me Scotland ke Roslin Institute me pehli baar bhed (sheep) 'Dolly' bana, jo apni 'maa' ki exact copy thi (isne prove kiya ki adult cells se bhi naya sajeev ban sakta hai). Baaki teen kuch nahi hain (Noor, Molly, Polly - tasveer ya doosre naam hain). Exam point: 'Duniya ka pehla cloned mammal = Dolly (bhed/sheep, 1996, Ian Wilmut)'.

qe: Which enzyme acts as the molecular 'Glue' to covalently seal nicks in phosphodiester backbones during recombinant DNA cloning?
qh: आनुवंशिक इंजीनियरिंग में डीएनए के कटे हुए टुकड़ों को आपस में जोड़ने वाला 'आणविक गोंद' (Molecular Glue) कौन सा एंजाइम है?
e: Concept: Recombinant DNA technology (gene ka cloning) me jab vector (plasmid) me gene daala jata hai, to uske sire (end) par gap/nick bach jata hai - usko pakka jodne ke liye khaas enzyme DNA Ligase use hota hai, jo phosphate-sugar ki kadi ('backbone') me covalent bond laga kar do tukdon ko 'glue' ki tarah seal kar deta hai (isliye ise molecular glue kehte hain); ise taaki bina DNA-polymerase use na kiya jaye. Baaki teen alag enzymes hain: Alkaline phosphatase, Reverse transcriptase (RNA se DNA), DNA Polymerase (naya DNA banata hai). Exam point: 'DNA jodne wala (molecular glue) = DNA Ligase'.

qe: Bacterial restriction endonucleases that recognize specific palindromic sequences and cleave double-stranded DNA are termed:
qh: डीएनए को विशिष्ट स्थलों पर काटने वाली 'आणविक कैंची' (Molecular Scissors) किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Bacteria me khaas enzymes hote hain jo bina ke (virus) DNA ko pehchankar kaat dete hain - ye pehchan ek khaas 'palindromic' sequence (aage-peeche ek jaisa padhne wala, jaise GAATTC) ki hoti hai, aur kaat wahan hoti hai jisse bina ka DNA kaam na kar paaye; isliye ye bacteria ki apni raksha ka hathyar hai. Biotech me yahi restriction enzymes gene kaatne-chhipkane ka 'surgical scissors' hain. Baaki teen alag enzymes hain: Topoisomerase (dhaage suljaata), Exonuclease (siro se kaatta), Helicase (DNA ki zip kholta). Exam point: 'Palindromic sequence par DNA kaatne wale = Restriction endonucleases (biotech ki scissors)'.

qe: The automated molecular technique that amplifies millions of copies of a specific target DNA sequence in vitro is the:
qh: डीएनए की एक छोटी सी मात्रा से उसकी लाखों प्रतियां तैयार करने वाली स्वचालित आणविक तकनीक कौन सी है?
e: Concept: PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction) ek aisi laboratory technique hai jisme DNA ke ek chhote hisse ki crores copies (amplification) banayi jaati hain - ye ek cycle me 3 steps se hota hai: Denaturation (DNA kholna), Annealing (primer judna) aur Extension (Taq polymerase se naya DNA) - aur ye cycle 30-35 bar chalaya jata hai (2^n copies). Isse COVID test, forensic DNA aur bimari ki jaanch hoti hai. Baaki teen alag techniques hain: Gel electrophoresis (DNA ko size ke hisaab se alag karna), Southern (DNA blot), Western (protein blot). Exam point: 'DNA ki millions copies in vitro = PCR (Taq polymerase ke saath)'.

qe: Golden Rice was bioengineered to combat global pediatric micronutrient deficiencies by biosynthesizing elevated levels of:
qh: विटामिन A की कमी और अंधेपन को दूर करने के लिए आनुवंशिक रूप से संशोधित 'गोल्डन राइस' में क्या प्रचुर मात्रा में होता है?
e: Concept: Golden Rice ek genetically engineered (transgenic) chawal ki kism hai jisme daffodil aur bacteria ke genes daal kar endosperm me Beta-carotene (Provitamin A) banana shuru karaya gaya - isse us chawal ka rang sunhara ho gaya (isliye 'Golden'); maqsad ye tha ki jahan log sirf chawal khate hain aur Vitamin A ki kami se bachche andha (night blindness) hote hain, wahan ye poshan de. Baaki teen alag biofortifications hain: Iron (jaise iron-rich bajra), Vitamin C, Alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E). Exam point: 'Golden Rice = Beta-carotene (Provitamin A) se Vitamin A ki kami ka ilaaj'.

qe: Transgenic Bt-cotton is biologically engineered to resist lepidopteran insect pests by expressing endotoxin crystal genes from:
qh: कीट प्रतिरोधी 'बीटी कपास' (Bt-Cotton) में किस मृदा जीवाणु से प्राप्त विषैला क्राय (Cry) प्रोटीन जीन डाला गया है?
e: Concept: Bt-cotton ek transgenic fasal hai jisme ek soil bacterium - Bacillus thuringiensis - ka endotoxin gene (Cry gene) daala gaya hai; ye gene paudhe me ek protein banata hai jo khaas caterpillar (lepidopteran) keedo (bollworm) ke pet me jaakar unka paachan rok deta hai aur wo mar jaate hain, lekin insaan aur doosre keede ko nuksaan nahi karta. Baaki teen alag bacteria hain: E. coli (research me), Agrobacterium tumefaciens (gene daalne ka vector), Pseudomonas putida (bioremediation). Exam point: 'Bt-cotton = Bacillus thuringiensis ka endotoxin gene (lepidopteran pests ke khilaf)'.

qe: Which of the following triplet codons functions as a 'Nonsense' or translation Stop Codon across eukaryotic mRNA transcripts?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'स्टॉप कोडॉन' (Stop Codon) है जो प्रोटीन संश्लेषण के समापन का संकेत देता है?
e: Concept: Start codon AUG (methionine) hai aur uske baad ribosome amino acid jodta jata hai; jab mRNA me koi 'Stop' codon aa jata hai to chain ruk jati hai, isliye unhe Nonsense ya Stop codon kehte hain - UAA 'Ochre', UAG 'Amber' aur UGA 'Opal'. Yahan UAA diya gaya hai. Baaki teen codon aise nahi hain: UGG tryptophan ka (amino acid deta hai), GUG valine ka, aur AUG start codon hai. Exam point: 'Stop codons = UAA, UAG, UGA (UAA sabse aam)'.

qe: Cri-du-chat (Cat's cry) syndrome is an autosomal structural chromosomal aberration caused by which mechanism?
qh: बिल्ली के रोने जैसी आवाज वाला 'क्राई-डू-चैट सिंड्रोम' (Cri-du-chat) किस गुणसूत्र की विकृति से होता है?
o: Terminal deletion of the short p-arm of chromosome 5 (5p-)
e: Concept: Cri-du-chat (billi ki aawaz wala) syndrome chromosome 5 ke chhote hath (short p-arm) ka aakhri hissa gayab (terminal deletion, 5p-) hone se hota hai; bachche ki rone ki aawaz billi ke maww jaisi hoti hai, sir chhota, aankhein door-door aur dimagi kamzori hoti hai. Isliye ye ek structural aberration hai (poora chromosome kam nahi, hissa gayab). Baaki teen alag mechanisms hain: Duplication 11, Inversion 9 (aam par harmless variant), Robertsonian translocation 14. Exam point: 'Cri-du-chat = chromosome 5 ke short arm ka deletion (5p-)'.

qe: Which model organism is widely dubbed the 'Drosophila of the Plant Kingdom' in molecular botanical genetics?
qh: पादप आनुवंशिकी में विस्तृत शोध के कारण किसे 'पादप जगत की ड्रोसोफिला' कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Arabidopsis thaliana (thale cress) ek chhota sa, jaldi badhne wala, ghaas jaisa paudha hai jiska genome bahut chhota hai aur uski poori DNA sequence jaldi padhi gayi - isliye ye plant research ka 'model organism' hai (jaise genetics me Drosophila), ise 'Drosophila of plant kingdom' kehte hain; iske experiments se phoolon ka vikas aur stress response samjha jata hai. Baaki teen fasal plants kam aasan model hain: Zea mays (makka), Pisum (matar), Oryza (chawal). Exam point: 'Plant kingdom ka Drosophila = Arabidopsis thaliana'.

qe: A single genetic locus that exerts simultaneous, pleiotropic phenotypic effects across multiple unrelated organ systems illustrates:
qh: जब एक ही जीन शरीर के कई असंबंधित शारीरिक लक्षणों को एक साथ प्रभावित करता है, तो इसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Ek gene ka asar aksar kai alag-alag angon par ek saath hota hai - is gun ko Pleiotropy kehte hain; jaise sickle cell ka ek hi gene RBC ka shape, til (spleen), haddi aur dard sab ko ek saath affect karta hai, ya Marfan syndrome me ek gene se aankh, dil aur ungliyan sab badalte hain. Baaki teen alag concepts hain: Incomplete penetrance (gene ho par lakshan na dikhe), Polygenic inheritance (kai gene milkar ek gun - jaise height), Epistasis (ek gene doosre ko dhak de). Exam point: 'Ek gene, kai lakshan = Pleiotropy'.

qe: Extranuclear non-Mendelian maternal inheritance in human cells is carried out by the replication of:
qh: कोशिका के केंद्रक के बाहर स्थित डीएनए, जो केवल माँ द्वारा संतानों में स्थानांतरित होता है, कहाँ पाया जाता है?
e: Concept: Kuch cheezein nucleus ke bahar (extranuclear) wale DNA se milti hain aur sabse aam misaal mitochondria hai - mtDNA (mitochondrial circular DNA). Kyunki mitochondria sirf maa ke egg se bacche ko milte hain (sperm ke mitochondria nikaal diye jaate hain), isliye ye gun sirf maa se aage jaate hain, isliye 'maternal inheritance' kehte hain (Mendel ke niyam yahan lagu nahi hote - jaise Leber's optic neuropathy). Baaki teen extranuclear DNA nahi rakhte: rRNA genes nucleus me, Centrosome plasmids (aise nahi hota), Golgi matrix (koi DNA nahi). Exam point: 'Maternal (non-Mendelian) inheritance = mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA, maa se)'.

qe: The Bombay Blood Group phenotype is genetically caused by the homozygous recessive inheritance of which mutant gene?
qh: अत्यंत दुर्लभ 'बॉम्बे ब्लड ग्रुप' (Bombay Blood Group) किस जीन के अप्रभावी होने के कारण H-एंटीजन नहीं बना पाता?
o: Recessive 'hh' alleles failing to synthesize basic H-substance
e: Concept: Bombay Blood Group (hh) me insaan ke paas H gene ka kaam nahi karta - ye H-substance (precursor) hi nahi banata jispar A aur B antigens chipakte hain; isliye uske RBC par na A, na B aur na H antigen hota, chahe uska 'asli' ABO genotype kuch bhi ho; natija ye hai ki usko kisi ABO group ka blood nahi diya ja sakta (sirf apne jaise Bombay group ka). Ye homozygous recessive 'hh' se hota hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Rh negative (dd), ii (O group), Duffy null. Exam point: 'Bombay blood group = recessive hh (H-substance ka na banna)'.

qe: In double-stranded B-DNA, Adenine pairs with Thymine via:
qh: डीएनए (DNA) की दोहरी कुंडली में एडिनीन (A) थाइमिन (T) के साथ कितने हाइड्रोजन बंधों द्वारा जुड़ता है?
e: Concept: DNA ke dono taraf ke bases ek doosre se khaas tarike se jude rehte hain (Chargaff's rule). A (adenine) hamesha T (thymine) ke saath judta hai aur unke beech do hydrogen bonds (A = T) hote hain; G (guanine) hamesha C (cytosine) ke saath judta hai aur unke beech teen hydrogen bonds (G = C) hote hain - isi jodi-bandi se double helix ka 'zipper' banta hai. Baaki teen galat hain: phosphodiester bond backbone me hota hai (base jodi me nahi), teen bonds G-C me hote hain, aur single covalent bond base pairing me nahi. Exam point: 'A = T (2 hydrogen bonds), G = C (3 hydrogen bonds)'.

qe: In double-stranded DNA, Guanine pairs with Cytosine via:
qh: डीएनए में ग्वानिन (G) साइटोसिन (C) के साथ कितने हाइड्रोजन बंधों द्वारा जुड़ता है?
e: Concept: Base pairing ka rule yahi hai: purine (A, G) hamesha pyrimidine (T, C) se judta hai. G aur C ke beech teen hydrogen bonds hote hain (A-T ke do se ek zyada), isliye G-C wala DNA zyada garam me tikta hai (higher melting point). Baaki teen galat hain: Disulfide bridge protein me hota hai, do hydrogen bonds A-T me hote hain, ionic bond nahi. Exam point: 'G = C = 3 hydrogen bonds (A = T se zyada mazboot)'. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Three Hydrogen Bonds (G C) hi thehrta hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: Which pyrimidine nitrogenous base is present exclusively in RNA in place of DNA's Thymine?
qh: आरएनए (RNA) में थाइमिन (Thymine) के स्थान पर कौन सा पिरीमिडीन क्षार पाया जाता है?
e: Concept: DNA aur RNA me chaar bases common hote hain (A, G, C, T/U), par ek antar yahi hai ki DNA me Thymine (T) hota hai jo RNA me nahi hota - uski jagah RNA me Uracil (U) hota hai (RNA me sugar Ribose hai aur DNA me Deoxyribose). Baaki teen bases dono me hote hain: Guanine, Cytosine, Adenine. Exam point: 'RNA ka khaas base = Uracil (U), DNA ka = Thymine (T)'. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Uracil hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: The enzymatic transcription of a genomic DNA template strand into a complementary primary RNA transcript is:
qh: डीएनए के टेम्पलेट से पूरक आरएनए (RNA) बनाने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Gene se protein banane ka pehla step Transcription hai - isme DNA ka ek hissa (template strand) khola jata hai aur uspar enzyme RNA polymerase ek complementary RNA (mRNA) bana deta hai (T ki jagah U). Iske baad us mRNA ko Translation me protein me badla jata hai. Baaki teen alag processes hain: Translation (mRNA se protein), Replication (DNA se DNA), Reverse transcription (RNA se DNA). Exam point: 'DNA -> mRNA = Transcription; mRNA -> protein = Translation'.

qe: The process whereby ribosomal complexes decode mRNA triplet codons into a linear polypeptide chain of amino acids is:
qh: राइबोसोम द्वारा mRNA के कोड को पढ़कर प्रोटीन का निर्माण करने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Translation (protein synthesis) me ribosome mRNA ki tape ko 3-3 bases (codon) ke group me padhta hai, aur har codon ke hisaab se tRNA sahi amino acid laata hai; is tarah amino acids ki chain (polypeptide/protein) banti hai. Isliye protein ka bhar DNA se mRNA ke through aata hai (Central Dogma: DNA -> RNA -> Protein). Baaki teen alag processes hain: Transcription (DNA se RNA), Reverse transcription (RNA se DNA), Splicing (mRNA ki safai). Exam point: 'mRNA ke codon se protein banana = Translation (ribosome par)'.

qe: What specific pentose sugar molecule forms the repeating sugar-phosphate backbone of a DNA polynucleotide?
qh: डीएनए (DNA) के न्यूक्लियोटाइड में कौन सी 5-कार्बन वाली पेंटोज शर्करा पाई जाती है?
e: Concept: DNA ka 'backbone' ek sugar aur phosphate ki chain hoti hai; us sugar ka naam DNA me 2'-Deoxyribose hai (isliye naam Deoxyribonucleic acid) - isme ribose se ek oxygen kam hota hai, jo DNA ko zyada stable banata hai (isliye DNA lambe samay tak safe rehta hai). RNA me ye sugar Ribose hoti hai. Baaki teen sugars alag hain: D-Glucose (energy), D-Ribose (RNA me), D-Fructose (fruit sugar). Exam point: 'DNA ka sugar = Deoxyribose (RNA me Ribose)'.

qe: Which structural basic proteins package eukaryotic chromosomal DNA into repetitive nucleosome spools?
qh: डीएनए को लपेटकर गुणसूत्र (Chromosome) बनाने में कौन सा क्षारीय प्रोटीन 'हिस्टोन कोर' का निर्माण करता है?
o: Histone Proteins (H2A, H2B, H3, H4, and H1)
e: Concept: DNA bahut lambi hoti hai, isliye uske choosne ke liye khaas basic (positively charged) proteins hote hain - Histones - jinpar DNA ki rassi lipat kar 'nucleosome' (manak/bead) banati hai. Ye 5 kism ke hote hain: H2A, H2B, H3, H4 (core octamer) aur H1 (linker). Baaki teen proteins alag kaam karte hain: Actin muscle/cell movement, Collagen connective tissue, Keratin baal-nakh. Exam point: 'DNA lapetne wale basic proteins = Histones (H2A, H2B, H3, H4, H1)'.

qe: What cytological term designates the specialized constricted heterochromatin region that holds sister chromatids together and anchors kinetochores?
qh: गुणसूत्र का वह संकुचित केंद्र भाग जो दो क्रोमैटिड्स को जोड़ता है और स्पिंडल फाइबर से जुड़ता है, क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Chromosome ke beech me ek sikuda hua khaas hissa hota hai jahan do 'sister chromatids' aapas me jude rehte hain aur jahan se division ke waqt spindle fibres pakadti hain - ise Centromere (primary constriction) kehte hain; ye chromosome ko 'V/L/i' jaisa aakar bhi deta hai aur iske sahi hone se hi chromosome sahi batte hain. Baaki teen alag parts/terms hain: Chromocenter (kuch heterochromatin ka joda), Telomere (aakhri sira/suraksha cap), Satellite (kuch chromosome par extra bhaag). Exam point: 'Sister chromatids ko jodne wala constriction + spindle ki site = Centromere'.

qe: The repetitive, specialized non-coding DNA capping the terminal ends of eukaryotic chromosomes to prevent genomic degradation is the:
qh: गुणसूत्र के दोनों अंतिम छोरों (पूंछ) को सुरक्षित रखने वाली विशिष्ट डीएनए टोपी को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Linear DNA ke aakhir par special repetitive, non-coding DNA ka cap hota hai - Telomere - jo chromosome ke sire ko 'plastic ke cap' ki tarah dhakta hai; isse chromosome ka aakhri hissa har division me ghista nahi, aur do chromosomes aapas me chipak (fusion) nahi jaate. Har division me telomere thoda chhota hota hai, aur bahut chhota ho jaye to cell budhi (senescent) ho jati hai - yahi 'umar ka ghadi' theory hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Satellite DNA (centromere ke paas), Centromere (beech ka jod), Kinetochore (protein hook). Exam point: 'Chromosome ke sire ka protective cap = Telomere'.

qe: Who experimentally proved that an in vitro synthetic gene could be chemically assembled in a laboratory (1968 Nobel Prize)?
qh: प्रयोगशाला में कृत्रिम जीन (Artificial Gene) का सफल रासायनिक संश्लेषण करने वाले भारतीय मूल के नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता वैज्ञानिक कौन थे?
e: Concept: Dr. Hargobind Khorana ko 1968 ka Nobel Prize is baat ke liye mila ki unhone laboratory me rasayanik taur par ek poora artificial gene (DNA) bana kar dikhaya aur 'genetic code' ko padhne me bhi bada yogdan diya (kaun sa codon kaun sa amino acid banata hai, ye bhi samjha). Baaki teen alag scientists hain: Homi Bhabha (nuclear physics), C.V. Raman (Raman effect), Venkatraman Ramakrishnan (ribosome structure, Nobel 2009). Exam point: 'Artificial gene ka chemical synthesis = Dr. Hargobind Khorana (1968 Nobel)'.

qe: Who first coined the term 'Chromosome' in 1888 for the thread-like basophilic nuclear bodies visible during mitosis?
qh: 1888 में केंद्रक के भीतर पाई जाने वाली धागे जैसी संरचनाओं को 'क्रोमोसोम' (गुणसूत्र) नाम किसने दिया था?
e: Concept: 1888 me German scientist Wilhelm von Waldeyer-Hartz ne pehli baar khaas lagi hue basophilic (rang-soakhne wale) daanon ko 'Chromosome' naam diya (chroma = rang, soma = body) - kyunki wo mitosis ke waqt rang se dikhte hain. Baaki teen alag scientists hain: Eduard Strasburger (mitosis ko describe kiya), Robert Brown (nucleus ki khoj), Walther Flemming (mitosis ke steps aur 'chromatin' shabd). Exam point: "'Chromosome' shabd 1888 me = Wilhelm von Waldeyer-Hartz (chroma + soma = rang + body)".
